{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers (all orders, including refunded)
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Confirm the premises
loyal_present = 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique()
converted_binary = set(df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1}
missing_in_loyal = loyal_df[['customer_segment', 'converted']].isnull().any().any()

# Compute the fraction of converted orders among all loyal orders
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(loyal_df)
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print results
print(f"'loyal' in customer_segment: {loyal_present}")
print(f"converted is binary: {converted_binary}")
print(f"Missing values in loyal group: {missing_in_loyal}")
print(f"Number of loyal orders: {n_total}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal orders: {n_converted}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
